sweet spot: how much error a release is allowed either side of the STRIKE NOW! moment, as a fraction of the wind-up. Inside it the strike does its damage and extends the food chain; outside it the dash is a pure speed boost. 0.05 on a 1s bar is 50ms early to 50ms late
